verdict.rationale: Ramp documents real-time receipt capture, auto-coding to GL accounts, auto-memo fill, and policy-based auto-approval at swipe time ([ramp-docs-8],[ramp-docs-32],[ramp-docs-45]), plus AI-driven detection of missing receipts/memos and reminders ([ramp-docs-29]) and accounting-sync integrations (QuickBooks/NetSuite/Xero) that push coded transactions in real time ([ramp-docs-44],[ramp-docs-27],[ramp-docs-28]), directly supporting month-end close as review not archaeology. Missing for 10: independent/third-party verification of close-cycle time reduction or accuracy rates beyond vendor claims.
